pages.name: London System: Poisoned Pawn Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 said White takes with ...Qxb2 and named c7 as a move; rewrote around 5...Qxb2 6.Nb5 (threat Nc7+) and Rb1. Plan 2 was vague; plan 4 now gives 5...c4 or 5...a6 (reviewer rejected an unconfirmed 5...Nc6 ...c4 line; fixed and re-accepted).

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Anti-Torre
pages.notes: Overview and plans called 2...Bg4 a pin, but the e2-pawn stands between f3 and d1. Plan 1 gave White moves in a Black plan. Rewrote overview (reviewer rejected a claim about sidestepping the London; fixed and re-accepted) and plans 1-2. British spelling in plans 3-4.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: Krause Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 named e5 as a pawn move although the e5 idea is a knight move and Nc6 covers e5; plan 4 was vague. Rewrote plans 3-4 around ...cxd4 Nxd4 and holding d5. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn Game: London System, with e6
pages.notes: Overview called the f4-bishop light-squared. Plan 3 gave an odd Nd2-f1-g3-e5 route to a square the f3-knight reaches at once; plan 4 named ...Nh5 with no knight able to get there. Plan 1 h4 replaced by the Bd3/queen battery on h7. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: 2.Nf3 Bf5 3.Bf4
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 called the f4-bishop light-squared; plan 2 named ...Nh5 with no knight able to reach it; plan 3 was a vague both-sides plan, now c4 and Qb3 against b7 and d5. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: 2.Nf3 Bf5 3.Bf4 c6
pages.notes: Plan 3 wrote the Slav triangle as a route c6-d5-e6; plan 4 sent the f3-knight to e5 via d2 (reviewer rejected Nbd2 as backing e5; fixed and re-accepted). British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: 2.Nf3 g6
pages.notes: Plan 2 (White) named Bg7, a Black piece. British spelling in the overview and plan 1.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.g3 Bg4
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 called ...Bg4 a pin (the e2-pawn blocks it); plan 3 called the exchange on f3 inevitable; plan 4 gave ...b5-Bb7 with the light-squared bishop already on g4. Rewrote plan 4 around ...Qd7, ...O-O-O, ...e5 and ...Bh3. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: 3.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote 0-0 and castled before e3; plan 3 called ...c5 a Slav-like structure; overview said the line is played against the Queen's Pawn Game. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Pawn: 3.g3 c6 4.Bg2 Bg4
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin and said it challenged e4 (reviewer rejected; fixed and re-accepted); plan 2 said trading on f3 creates pawn weaknesses (the g2-bishop recaptures) and named ...dxc4 with no c4-pawn; plan 3 had a knight on d2 that is not there; plan 4 called the f8-bishop light-squared. British spelling.
